mentions.name: Finbodhi
mentions.description: Personal finance app that helps users track, understand, benchmark, and plan their finances using double-entry accounting. It is local-first with encrypted cross-device sync, supports multi-account (family or advisor) and multi-currency tracking, includes a custom sheet/calculator for operating on accounts such as tax calculations, fetches prices for Indian investment vehicles and US stocks, and offers custom dashboards with leading/trailing/rolling charts for benchmarking investments.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://finbodhi.com - An app for your financial journey. It helps you track, understand, benchmark and plan your finances - with double-entry accounting.
mentions.author: ciju

mentions.name: Finbodhi
mentions.description: Personal finance app for tracking, understanding, benchmarking, and planning finances with double-entry accounting. Local-first with cross-device sync and in-transit encryption, it supports multiple accounts (family or advisor use), multi-currency, a custom sheet/calculator for operations like tax calculations, prices for most Indian investment vehicles and US stocks, and custom dashboards with leading/trailing/rolling return charts plus family-level networth, cashflow, and income views.
mentions.audience: Individuals and families tracking personal finances, including advisors managing multiple accounts
mentions.source_excerpt: https://finbodhi.com — It's an app for your financial journey. It helps you track, understand, benchmark and plan your finances - with double-entry accounting. You own your financial data.
mentions.author: ciju
